Gjensidige Forsikring ASA: Acquisition of own shares / primary insider trades

 2026-10-27 19:45:59

On 26 and 27 October 2026, DNB Carnegie acquired a total of 104,367 shares in Gjensidige Forsikring ASA ("Gjensidige" or the "Company", OSE:GJF, LEI 5967007LIEEXZX6FAO47, ISIN NO0010582521) on behalf of the Company, as further specified in the attached overviews of trades. 82,977 shares have been sold to employees at a price of NOK 262.2629 per share as part of Gjensidige's share savings scheme for 2026. 
For a description of the share savings scheme, see the stock exchange release dated 19 December 2025. Acquisition of shares under the share savings scheme for the third quarter of 2026 is now complete. 
Primary insiders in Gjensidige have on 27 October 2026 received shares in the Company as part of the share savings scheme for 2026. See attachment for details on the acquisition of shares by primary insiders. 
Following the purchase and sale of shares for the third quarter of 2026 in connection with the share savings scheme, Gjensidige will own 20,075 own shares. 
This information is subject to the disclosure requirements pursuant to article 19 of Regulation (EU) No 596/2014 and section 5-12 of the Norwegian Securities Trading Act. 
Contact: Head of Investor Relations, Berit Nilsen. Tel: +47 976 60 704
